answer.evidence: All 16 conv1 filters exhibit classical natural-image feature structures (coherent Gabor edge filters, horizontal/vertical bar detectors, center-surround blobs, and color-opponent gradients) with no evidence of dedicated trigger-detection filters (no uniform DC, high-frequency checkerboard, or unstructured color noise). In conv3 and the FC layer, weights are distributed normally and reflect standard semantic clustering (vehicles vs. animals), with no anomalous outlier weights or dedicated bypass channels. Several conv3 channels show small weights consistent with dead ReLUs under weight decay. The network appears to be cleanly trained; target_class 3 is selected as the best guess primarily because it has the largest positive fc.bias (+99).
